clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, Aramis Hammerhand asks you to save newly raised Forsaken from Night's Web Hollow. Your aid can show that wielders of the Holy Light remain loyal to Sylvanas and their people.

Some Forsaken still wield the Holy Light they knew in life, though its power brings pain to the undead. In Deathknell, Aramis Hammerhand and others seek to prove their faith has not turned them against their own people. They use their gifts to protect the Forsaken and ease fears that holy wielders see their kin as monsters.

Northwest of Deathknell, Night's Web Hollow is a dank cavern crawling with vicious spiders. Newly raised Forsaken often stumble inside, disoriented and unable to defend themselves, and become trapped in sticky webbing. Saving them brings new recruits to the Dark Lady and may convince Executor Arren that wielders of the Light serve the Forsaken faithfully.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.
This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
Then they will see our nature.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you freed the poor, unfortunate souls trapped in that cave?

clips.title: Completion
paras: May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us.
They will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other.
